Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.sms

Class SendSmsOneTimeCodeUseCase

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.sms.SendSmsOneTimeCodeUseCase
@Service @Transactional(noRollbackFor=SmsRefusedException.class) public class SendSmsOneTimeCodeUseCase extends Object
Requests an SMS inside the cost policy: the country must be served and the spending of the window and of the day, including this message, must stay within their caps.

The cost is reserved by SmsCostLedgerRepository.tryRecord(java.time.Instant, java.lang.String, long, com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.sms.SmsSpendCap, com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.sms.SmsSpendCap), which checks both caps and records the message in one atomic step, so concurrent senders cannot overshoot a budget and a refused message costs nothing. The message itself is not sent here: an SmsRequested event is published and sent after the transaction commits, off the request thread, so the gateway is never called inside a transaction and a rolled-back request sends nothing. A refusal does not roll the surrounding transaction back (noRollbackFor): this use case is joined by its callers, and a rollback-only mark here would undo what they saved.
